newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: HG Asia, JV approved for Seoul bourse seats.
newsitem.headline: HG Asia, JV approved for Seoul bourse seats.

text.p: HG Asia Securities Ltd and a South Korean-U.S. joint venture have been approved for seats on the Korea Stock Exchange, an exchange statement said on Friday.
HG Asia will be a special member, which does not carry voting rights, and KEB-SB Securities Co Ltd, a full member.
KEB-SB is 51 percent owned by the Korea Exchange Bank and 49 percent by Smith Barney.
HG Asia becomes the fourth foreign member on the exchange after Jardine Fleming Securities, ING Baring Securities and Morgan Stanley Securities.
KEB-SB is the third joint venture member, after Dongbang Peregrine Securities and Hannuri-Salomon Securities.
The stock exchange now has 38 members.
